title: Oct 14 Results + Oct 15 Preview: Sometimes You Take the L and Learn
summary: A tough 0-1 day in LA, but tomorrow brings a fresh slate with the Rays in Cleveland

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Yesterday

Sometimes baseball just doesn't go the way the numbers suggest it should. We had one game on the slate Monday—Brewers visiting the Dodgers—and we backed LA with 56% confidence. The baseball gods had other plans. Milwaukee pulled off the upset, and we're sitting at 0-1 for the day.

Not the start to the week we were hoping for, but here's what I love about this game: tomorrow always brings new opportunities.

## The Dodgers Miss: What Happened?

Look, 56% confidence isn't a slam dunk—it never was meant to be. That's basically saying it's a coin flip with a slight edge to the home team. The Dodgers had the home field advantage and the better overall roster construction, but the Brewers showed up ready to play.

That's October baseball for you. The margins are razor-thin, and any team can beat any team on any given night. The model called it close because it *was* close.

## Looking Ahead: October 15th Preview

Here's where things get interesting. Tomorrow we're heading to Cleveland, where the Guardians host the Tampa Bay Rays. Our model likes Tampa Bay in this one—not by a ton, but enough to make them our top pick for Tuesday.

## The Pitching Matchup to Watch

Griffin Jax takes the ball for Tampa Bay, while Gavin Williams counters for Cleveland. This is one of those matchups where experience and execution could tip the scales either way.

The Rays are getting a narrow nod here at 54%—again, we're talking about a tight game where small details matter. But there's something about Tampa Bay's approach in these situations that gives them a slight edge in our projection model.

Cleveland at home is never an easy out, especially at Progressive Field. The Guardians have been scrappy all year, and their home crowd will be buzzing. But the numbers point us toward the visitors in this American League showdown.

## The Bottom Line

Yesterday stung—no way around it. Going 0-1 on a single-game slate means there's nowhere to hide. But that's also what makes tomorrow exciting. We get a fresh chance with Rays-Guardians, a close matchup where our edge might be small, but it's still an edge.

The beauty of baseball is that every day the slate wipes clean. Let's see if Tampa Bay can get us back in the win column.

*See you tomorrow with the results.* ⚾

author: Hana
